author: Bobby Grayson
description: Source: https://gaearon.github.io/conway-refinement/ (built from aa860765). LeanArchitect upstream exports via 'lake build :blueprintJson' to .lake/build/blueprint; the importer accepts both 'dependencies/proofDependencies' and 'uses/proofUses' field names.
title: Dan's site embeds BlueprintData JSON in a <script id=blueprint-data> tag; no standalone nodes.json is published. Statements are pre-rendered MathJax HTML, so the importer skips HTML statements
